question: Which of the following location has NOT been selected for setting up the seven PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Park for the textile sector announced by the Government of India in March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Parks aim to strengthen India’s textile sector and boost its global competitiveness.
 
• The seven selected locations for PM MITRA Parks include Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Gujarat, Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra.
 
• West Bengal is not among the selected states for PM MITRA Parks as announced by the Government of India in March 2023.
 
• The scheme is designed to provide world-class infrastructure for the textile sector and attract investments worth ₹70,000 crore.
 
• The PM MITRA Parks are being developed under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, ensuring collaboration between the government and the private sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PM MITRA Scheme:**

 
 
• PM MITRA was launched under the vision of “Make in India” and “Atmanirbhar Bharat” to position India as a global hub for textile manufacturing and exports.
 
• The scheme is inspired by the 5F vision—Farm to Fibre to Factory to Fashion to Foreign.
 
• Each park will have an integrated facility including spinning, weaving, dyeing, and printing units along with commercial spaces.
 
 
 
• **Textile Industry in India:**
 
 
• India’s textile industry is one of the largest in the world, contributing approximately 2% to the GDP.
 
• The industry employs over 45 million people and is a major contributor to India’s export earnings.
 
• India is the world's largest producer of cotton and jute, and the second-largest producer of polyester and silk.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives for Textiles:**
 
 
• Other initiatives like the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles aim to promote manufacturing and attract investments.
 
• Integrated Textile Parks Scheme has previously been implemented to enhance textile infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Global Textile Market:**
 
 
• India competes with countries like China, Bangladesh, and Vietnam in textile exports.
 
• PM MITRA Parks are expected to increase India’s share in the global textile market significantly.
